column1: # Pokémon Scarlet 1.0.0, Game Freak's Trinity engine, SDK 13.3.5.
# Only 1.0.0 is registered; use -p v0 when the NSP folder also has updates.
# The 3D layout exposes the right stick for the camera and the D-pad.
# The game calls nvnDeviceSetDepthMode(near=0); prepare the same main0_z bases
# offline so the first run can use them instead of repeating the full prebuild.
# subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie; the host supplies its imported entry points.
# The 4 GB allocator reservation (patches.py), 62 MB SDK node area and 32 MB
# region alignment fit in the alias region. See README.md for the startup probes.
# Startup allocates and frees everything allocatable. The SDK releases those
# cached pages only after a map fails at the real application-pool limit.
# The game's swap chain has 2 textures at interval 1, so it gets one back only
# once the display link has taken the previous present and a frame that misses a
# tick waits a whole extra one: the render thread parked in
# nvnWindowAcquireTexture for 50-64 ms on frames whose GPU work was 13-18 ms.
# Snapshots copy each present at once, so the swapchain texture frees
# immediately; the wait becomes the ring's own, 2.69 ms per frame (max 3.17).
# Measured over 143,100 frames on the Mac: every one of 481 windows at 33.33 ms
# p50, against 30,000-frame blocks of 42.8 dropped per 300 before. README.md.
